mutations.name: Jcode host applies the requested reasoning effort to its session
mutations.expectRed: requested variant reaches the session as its reasoning effort

mutations.name: Jcode host refuses the launch when the provider rejects the tier
mutations.find: throw new Error(`jcode connector: reasoning effort ${JSON.stringify(config.variant)} was refused for model ${JSON.stringify(model ?? "(the provider default)")} — ${(error as Error).message}`);
mutations.expectRed: a tier the provider refuses ends the launch

mutations.name: The render-in-full exception stays keyed to messages this host composes
mutations.expectRed: child stderr forging the refusal's wording does not reach the operator

mutations.name: Jcode host retries the mandatory readiness proof after the first-turn MCP snapshot race
mutations.find:
if (!hasOrientation(readiness))
      readiness = await client.run(sessionId, readinessPrompt, { autoApprove: true });
mutations.replace:
if (false)
      readiness = await client.run(sessionId, readinessPrompt, { autoApprove: true });
mutations.expectRed: a first-turn MCP snapshot race is retried once

mutations.name: Jcode host still refuses a permanently absent cotal tool after the bounded retry
mutations.expectRed: a permanently absent cotal tool ends the launch
